text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a config-only rollout for routing weight floor + batch timeout changes for the `small-latency` model-group. Change window 22:00-23:30 PT. Will go canary -> 25% -> 100%.

maria: Key diffs: routing.floor=0.07 -> 0.12, batch.max_wait_ms=40 -> 25, kvcache.prefix_eviction=enabled. No model binary changes.

jamie: ACK. Observability checks: per-tenant tail-latency, token throughput, and error-rate on canary.

sanjeev: noted. I can watch infra metrics and warm pools during canary. ops-oncall will watch SLO alerts.

deploy-bot: [queued] config-rollout config-stitch:v2 -> canary (target=small-latency, change_window=22:00-23:30 PT) by maria — runbook linked: https://go/release/runbooks/config-stitch-v2

maria: Quick sanity snippet for infra team:
```
routes:
  - model_group: small-latency
    routing_floor: 0.12
    batch: { max_wait_ms: 25, max_tokens: 512 }
cache:
  prefix_eviction: true
```

lia: Thx, will validate no quota/regression hits for our heavyweight tenants.

deploy-bot: [started] canary stage at 22:05 PT — 5% traffic. Canary hosts: r-infer-canary-12/13.

sanjeev: Canary warmed, pools up. No errors so far. P95 latency dropped ~6ms, P99 steady. Logs clean.

ops-oncall: Alert watch active. No new SLO alerts in the past 10m. CPU/GPU utilization normal.

jamie: Running a few synthetic prompt sets against canary now (prompt set: quick-latency-regress). Outputs look fine. No hallucination regressions.

maria: Good. Proceeding to 25% in 5m if no flags. Any objections?

lia: No objections. Will watch tenant X which is sensitive to routing.floor.

deploy-bot: [in-progress] rollout to 25% at 22:20 PT.

sanjeev: At 25% — tail latency still good, throughput up ~3%. One tenant reported slight increase in cold-call latency (tenant-id: 8421), investigating.

lia: Tenant 8421 sees a handful of 500s from edge buckets, not directly tied to model. Opening ticket: INF-4829.

maria: Not rolling back for now but hold at 25% while we confirm 8421. If INF-4829 spikes or error-rate > 0.5% for any top-10 tenant, we rollback.

ops-oncall: Adding automated probe: if error_rate > 0.5% for any tenant for 3m -> rollback trigger.

deploy-bot: [monitoring] health hooks enabled.

sanjeev: 8421 errors stayed at 0.08% after mitigations (sticky edge flow fixed). No increase in model errors.

jamie: Running longer evals — quality pass. No regressions in BLEU/ROUGE-ish checks we use for these workloads.

maria: OK to continue to 100% in a slow ramp over 15m, ops keep the auto-rollback hook live.

deploy-bot: [ramping] moving to 50% -> 75% -> 100% over next 15m (staggered windows). Next check at 22:40 PT.

ops-oncall: Watching SLOs. Will call rollback if automated trigger fires or P99 jumps > 50ms.

sanjeev: At 75% — small bump in P99 (~18ms), within expected tradeoff for batch wait reduction. No errors related to model runtime.

lia: Tenant X (sensitive) passed 10m sanity. No action.

deploy-bot: [complete] rollout to 100% finished at 22:58 PT. config-stitch:v2 active for small-latency.

maria: Nice. Post-rollout checklist: 1) confirm observability dashboards updated, 2) tag release in internal changelog, 3) schedule a 24h watch.

jamie: I updated the dashboard panels and pinned a short note on the graph for the change.

lia: Logged change in changelog: "config-stitch v2: routing floor increase & tighter batch max_wait" — linked tenants tested.

ops-oncall: 24h watch started. No regression alerts at 60m and 3h checks.

maria: Closing this thread unless anyone sees anomalies. Thanks all! :tada:
